seasons.name: Miniseries
seasons.overview: In the distant future – long after the Empire and the Rebel Alliance, when the Jedi have faded into legend – Lah Kara, the daughter of Lah Zhima, leaves her home alongside new Jedi allies to free her father from the clutches of Jedi Hunters. Kara's father is the only known sabersmith in the galaxy, making the lightsaber – and Zhima himself – an invaluable asset.

reviews.author: Joogle83
reviews.content:
Watched The Ninth Jedi with Kimiko Glenn(Spider-Man Into The Spider-Verse) as Lah Kara, Andrew Koshino (Star Wars The Clone Wars,Marvel  Rivals) as Juro, Masi Oka( Heroes) as Ethan   ,Patrick Seltz(My Hero Academia) as Homen J.P. Karilak(Justice League ) as Gramps , Gideon Adlon(The Craft: Legacy) as Devon Ishara, Simu Liu(Shang-Chi And The Legend Of The Ten Rings) as Lah Zhima , Keone Young(Star Wars Rebels) as Kwana, Chase Sui Wonders(The Studio) as Lady  Tafflah , Feodor Chin (Overwatch) as Gennoh and Young Mazino(Beef) as Nawamm.

**Star Wars: Visions** knocked it out of the park with *"The Ninth Jedi."* It’s a masterclass in non-canon storytelling, fusing the magic of the Original Trilogy with the best parts of *Ahsoka*, *Rogue One*, and *The Last Jedi*.

Kara’s quest to find her father gives the story immense heart, while the color-shifting Kyber lore brings back early Star Wars concepts in a thrilling way. Nawann is an absolute powerhouse of a villain—part Vader, part Kylo Ren, part Baylan Skoll—and along with Kara, anchors the series with incredible voice acting.

It isn't without minor flaws: the early pacing stumbles slightly, the superweapon trope makes an appearance (even if cleverly used), and Kara's blaster-wielding hunter ally deserved a bit more screen time.

Still, the potential here is massive. Between *"The Ninth Jedi,"* *"The Ronin,"* and standout Season 3 shorts like *"The Song On Four Wings,"* *"The Bounty Hunters,"* and *"The Smuggler,"* Lucasfilm needs to green light dedicated mini-series. Doubling down on grounded, non-Jedi stories—a formula that worked wonders for *Rogue One*, *Solo*, *The Mandalorian*, and *Andor*—proved that the Force is alive and well in anime.

   Show running by Kenji Kamiyama(Ghost In The Shell Standalone Complex) & Josh Rimes(Star Wars The Bad Batch ), The Force Is Strong With Star Wars debut into Anime 8.5/10
